name: nextprompt
description: Codex Next Prompt: generates your next prompt from the conversation context and copies it to your clipboard.

interface.shortDescription: Your next prompt, ready to paste.
interface.longDescription: Suggests follow-ups for unfinished work and copies the quoted prompt. After installation, run setup to check Python and activate the hooks. Hook trust must be reviewed in Codex.
defaultPrompt: Use $nextprompt-onboarding to introduce NextPrompt and check this installation.
